Metadata.title: Astrea — Escrow-Backed Prize Payouts on Stellar
Metadata.description: Escrow-backed prize payouts for hackathons, bounties, and community challenges — powered by Stellar smart escrows.

HomePage.title: Astrea
HomePage.tagline: Escrow-backed prize payouts for hackathons, bounties, and community challenges — funds locked on-chain before the event starts.
HomePage.mvpNotice: MVP in active development. See the <link>build plan</link> for what's next.
HomePage.audienceTitle: Are you here as a participant or organizer?
HomePage.audienceSubtitle: Astrea provides dedicated tools and trustless escrows tailored to both sides of every competition.
HomePage.participantRoleDesc: Compete with peace of mind. Every prize pool is locked in smart contract escrow before you submit a single line of code.
HomePage.organizerRoleDesc: Launch hackathons and bounty tracks with guaranteed credibility. Lock prize funds, assign judges, and release payouts seamlessly.
HomePage.finalCtaTitle: Start running credible prize competitions today
HomePage.finalCtaDesc: Join organizers and builders building the future of transparent, on-chain prize distribution on Stellar.

SeeItInAction.title: Real-time verifiable escrow tracking
SeeItInAction.description: Every event hosted on Astrea features on-chain escrow validation, milestone breakdown, and transparent payout proofs.
SeeItInAction.feature1Desc: Prize funds are committed to Stellar Soroban contracts before hackathons begin.
SeeItInAction.feature2Desc: Release prizes individually as judges evaluate deliverables without blocking other winners.

HowItWorks.title: How Astrea Works
HowItWorks.subtitle: From creation to payout, every step of the prize lifecycle is secured on the Stellar network.
HowItWorks.step1Desc: Organizers configure prize tracks, award categories, milestones, and assign reputable judges with dispute fallback.
HowItWorks.step2Desc: Prize funds are locked into Stellar Soroban smart contracts, immediately granting the event a verified public badge.
HowItWorks.step3Desc: Builders submit projects while appointed judges score and review submissions against transparent evaluation rubrics.
HowItWorks.step4Desc: Winners receive instant payouts in USDC with verifiable on-chain transaction receipts and explorer links.

ParticipantPage.title: Build with guaranteed payouts
ParticipantPage.tagline: Never worry about unfulfilled prize promises. Every competition on Astrea locks funds in smart escrows before launch.
ParticipantPage.card1Desc: Check the on-chain contract address and confirmed USDC balances before spending your time.
ParticipantPage.card2Desc: Win and receive funds directly into your Stellar wallet with zero manual invoice delays.
ParticipantPage.card3Desc: Designated resolvers and transparent judge scoring protect your work against unfair dismissals.
ParticipantPage.ctaDesc: Connect your Stellar wallet to get started with active hackathons and verified bounties.

OrganizerPage.title: Host trusted prize competitions
OrganizerPage.tagline: Attract top-tier builders by proving your prize pool is real, funded, and locked on Stellar.
OrganizerPage.card1Desc: Configure ranked payouts, category prizes, milestone splits, and sponsor bounties in minutes.
OrganizerPage.card2Desc: Invite team members and industry experts to review and score submissions with ease.
OrganizerPage.card3Desc: Release milestone payouts to verified recipient wallets with automated trustline validation.
OrganizerPage.ctaDesc: Create your first escrow-backed hackathon or bounty track on Stellar testnet today.

ResolverReview.pageSubtitle: Adjudicate contested or stalled milestone for {eventTitle}.
ResolverReview.connectWalletDesc: Connect your Stellar wallet to verify your role as the designated escrow resolver.
ResolverReview.unauthorizedDesc: Connected wallet ({connected}) does not match the designated escrow resolver ({expected}). Only the appointed resolver can adjudicate this dispute.
ResolverReview.priorWinnerExplanation: The assigned judge evaluated submissions and recorded this winner prior to going inactive past the deadline.
ResolverReview.noPriorWinnerNotice: No prior winner evaluation was recorded by the judge before the deadline. The resolver must review the submitted evidence directly to determine the recipient.
ResolverReview.resolutionConfirmedSubtitle: Prize release has been executed and confirmed on the Stellar network.
ResolverReview.stateUpdateDesc: Milestone status has transitioned from DISPUTED directly to PAID_OUT per protocol rule ADR-007. The winner can access funds immediately.
ResolverReview.actionSectionSubtitle: Review the recipient wallet and submit your binding decision on-chain.
ResolverReview.winnerAddressInputHelp: The 56-character Stellar public key that will receive the escrowed prize.
ResolverReview.adjudicationRationaleHelp: Explain why this release is authorized based on submission scores or judge inactivity.
ResolverReview.adjudicationRationalePlaceholder: Document why the prize is being released to this recipient (minimum 15 characters)...
ResolverReview.termsDeclaration: I confirm that I have reviewed the evidence in good faith, and I understand this release transaction is final and irrevocable.
ResolverReview.honestStateNotice: Honest transaction confirmation — never assumed successful before ledger inclusion
ResolverReview.unauthorizedError: Your connected wallet is not the authorized resolver.
ResolverReview.invalidWinnerWallet: Please provide a valid 56-character Stellar address starting with 'G'.
ResolverReview.reasoningTooShort: Adjudication rationale must be at least 15 characters.
ResolverReview.termsRequired: You must accept the terms of adjudication.
ResolverReview.genericSubmitError: Failed to submit resolution. Please try again.
